entries.en: Added background agent support. Agents run in the background while you work
entries.zh: 添加了后台代理支持。当您工作时，代理会在后台运行

entries.en: Added --disable-slash-commands CLI flag to disable all slash commands
entries.zh: 添加了 --disable-slash-commands CLI 标志以禁用所有斜杠命令

entries.en: Added model name to "Co-Authored-By" commit messages
entries.zh: 将模型名称添加到“Co-Authored-By”提交消息中

entries.en: Enabled "/mcp enable [server-name]" or "/mcp disable [server-name]" to quickly toggle all servers
entries.zh: 启用“/mcp启用[服务器名称]”或“/mcp禁用[服务器名称]”以快速切换所有服务器

entries.en: VSCode: Added support for multiple terminal clients connecting to the IDE server simultaneously
entries.zh: VS Code：支持多个终端客户端同时连接到 IDE 服务器

entries.en: Updated Fetch to skip summarization for pre-approved websites
entries.zh: 对预先批准的网站，Fetch 跳过摘要
